name: Arjun Menon
text: The team let me test drive for a full hour with no pressure. The price they quoted was the price I paid, with no hidden charges at delivery.

name: Priya Raman
text: I was nervous about switching to electric. They explained charging, range and running costs clearly, and even helped me install a home charger.

name: Karthik Subramanian
text: Finance approval came the next day and the EMI plan was easy to follow. Delivery was two days later than promised, but they kept me updated.

name: Divya Nair
text: My first service was handled with pickup and drop, and the car came back washed. Good communication from start to finish.

name: Rahul Verma
text: I compared four showrooms. Apex was the only one that showed me the full on-road price up front and answered every question honestly.

name: Meena Krishnan
text: A great buying experience. The trade-in valuation for my old car was fair and the paperwork was done in one visit.
